milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' is an observation/locate task — the player must navigate near the gravel deposit and face it. Target is the center of the gravel patch at spawn-relative (5, 0, 5). Max distance of 5 blocks ensures the player must walk at least ~2 blocks from spawn (spawn-to-target distance is ~7.07 blocks). Facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is actually looking toward the gravel.

Uses inventory_has because mining orange concrete powder causes it to drop as an item into the player's inventory. Orange concrete powder always drops itself (unlike gravel which can drop flint), making this a reliable check. The block breaks instantly by hand — no tool needed.
